operation.description: Use this API to cancel an order on behalf of a seller. In the US and UK markets, when an item is out of stock, partial cancellation on the single item level is supported by this API.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

cancel_reason.description:
Reason to cancel the order 
Please see "Return API Overview" for a list of reasons a seller can select to cancel the order.

order_line_item_ids.description: List of order line item ids to cancel. In the US and UK markets, when an item is out of stock, partial cancellation on the single item level is supported. To initiate a partial cancellation, specify the item's order line id.

quantity.description: The quantity of SKU to cancel

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

cancel_id.description: The identifier of a specific order cancellation.

cancel_status.description:
The status of an order cancellation request. 
Available values:
- CANCELLATION_REQUEST_PENDING
- CANCELLATION_REQUEST_SUCCESS
- CANCELLATION_REQUEST_CANCEL
- CANCELLATION_REQUEST_COMPLETE

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
